text:
Maya: heads up — saw a 3x increase in spot interruptions in us-east-1 over the last 30m, impacting p3-mix pools. Latency SLOs spiking for high-throughput customers.
kevin: yikes. any pattern? single AZ or multi-AZ?
Maya: mostly AZ-a and AZ-c. churn looks correlated with scheduled host maintenance + some network flaps.
Ana: are autoscaler logs showing rapid scale-in? could be greedily reclaiming nodes.
kevin: autoscaler did an aggressive binpack yesterday after jobs finished. scaled back too fast.
Maya: yeah, but even with slower scale-in, interruption rate on spots would have still hit us. we need a routing strategy that tolerates spot churn without sending i-requests to slow CPU fallbacks immediately.
Sam: proposal: layered soft-degrade model — primary = gpu model, secondary = quantized v2 (GPU cheaper variant), tertiary = cpu skinny model. Prefer intra-region GPU quantized before region failover. keeps latency lower than CPU fallback.
Lina: +1. also add per-customer tiering: for platinum customers allow cross-region failover to eu-west-1 before CPU fallback; for free-tier, CPU fallback first.
ops-oncall: how do we keep KV cache useful across variants? switching models loses prefix cache.
Ana: idea — keep a shared prefix cache keyed by (customer, request-prefix-hash) and store serialized KV for compatible model families. when switching to quantized variant we attempt cache restore; if miss, warm async.
Maya: we should also implement a short "spill TTL" window — if a request is interrupted, we probabilistically spill subsequent requests for the same session to a more stable pool for next N seconds. reduces oscillation when churn is bursty.
kevin: sample config I sketched:
```
routing_policy: {
  primary_pools: [gpu-standard],
  fallback_chain: [gpu-quantized, cross-region-gpu, cpu-slim],
  spill_ttl_ms: 15000,
  spill_prob_on_interrupt: 0.9,
  max_cross_region_latency_ms: 120
}
```
Sam: we need to be careful with cost — cross-region GPUs are expensive. limit cross-region attempts per-customer-per-minute, and only for tiers with SLA.
Lina: agree. add a budget counter in routing layer that decrements on cross-region allocation and refills slowly.
deploy-bot: autoscaler: scaled down pool gpu-standard-us-east-1 by 12 nodes at 2026-03-18T15:12:03Z (reason: binpack reclaim)
ops-oncall: can we add a quick mitigation: disable aggressive binpack policy during known maintenance windows + increase min-nodes for p3-mix by +5 for 1h?
Maya: doing that now for AZ-a/c. will also flip spill_ttl to 20s temporarily.
kevin: testing plan — run a synthetic churn test: simulate 30% preempt rate for 10m, verify tail latency < 350ms for platinum, < 800ms for free tier, and CPU-fallback rate < 10% for platinum.
Ana: I'll add unit tests for KV cache restore path and e2e for session spill logic.
Sam: any metrics we should add?
Lina: add counter: routed_fallbacks_by_reason (interrupt|capacity|network), spill_events_per_session, cross_region_falls, cache_restore_success_rate.
Maya: I'll create a dashboard and alert: if cross_region_falls > 5/min for platinum -> page.
kevin: timeline?
Maya: quick mitigations in next hour (autoscaler tweak + spill_ttl bump). infra change for routing policy and cache restore tests tomorrow afternoon.
Lina: noted. I'll draft the config changes and a short runbook for oncall.
Sam: sounds good. thanks all :thumbsup:
